title: Understanding and Defending VLM Jailbreaks via Jailbreak-Related Representation Shift
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mechanistic analysis of jailbreaks in Vision-Language Models and the development of a defense method. While it utilizes safety-related keywords including 'unethical' to detect safety warnings in model responses, it does not study, evaluate, or benchmark religion, faith, moral reasoning, or specific ethical frameworks.
